mappings.note: What one should ask a sadhu (his knowledge, not his caste) -- Kabir's rejection of caste, the saakhi's social value; LO-101 would reduce the doha's whole point to a retrieved detail.
What the poet says should be valued -- a point read out of the doha, asked as a what and not as a judgement.
What kind of word 'gaari' is -- tadbhav classification, the written language-system LO.
What we tell in the hand (the maala) -- a concrete image located in the doha.
Whom Kabir teaches us not to slander -- a moral precept, so the social-values LO.
Which act Kabir holds to be bad -- a value judgement the saakhis make.
What Kabir's collection of dohas is known as -- identifying the composition itself, not analysing it.
Why pride should be given up -- asks the reason behind a value, which is LO-100's 'uske kaaran jaanne ki koshish'.
